gaps.root_cause: .gitignore line 6 (`**/*.md`) blanket-ignores every markdown file repo-wide and is only negated for governance/, .agents/ (fixed in wave P0-E), tools/remediation/ (fixed in wave P0-E), tools/checklist/, tools/prompts/, and a few individually named files. docs/ and infra/ have no negation, so any new markdown file placed there silently never gets tracked. Found two real, substantive, pre-existing documents that were never committed as a result: docs/MIGRATION_SAFETY.md and infra/docker/PRODUCTION_ARCHITECTURE.md (confirmed via `git log --all` returning no history for either).
gaps.required_action: Decide, per directory, whether to add a negation (matching the governance/.agents/tools-remediation pattern) or to intentionally exclude specific paths, then track docs/MIGRATION_SAFETY.md and infra/docker/PRODUCTION_ARCHITECTURE.md (or archive them if superseded). Audit for any other silently-dropped file across the whole tree before closing.
forbidden_actions: Deleting either document without confirming it is superseded
Blanket-untracking .gitignore without auditing what else it currently hides

gaps.root_cause: Discovered while closing GAP-0003 (iteration 2): enforce-allowed-paths.mjs and scope-expansion-gate.mjs compute changed files as `git diff source.baseSha...HEAD`. This is only accurate when a task's repair happens on an isolated child branch created at baseSha. When a task is instead repaired directly on a shared work branch (this session's operating mode, since no child-branch-per-task automation exists yet — that is wave P0-E's Agent Controller role, still human-gated), every unrelated commit landed on the branch since baseSha shows up as a false OUTSIDE_ALLOWED_PATHS / scope-expansion violation.
gaps.required_action: Either (a) always create an isolated child branch per task before repair (matching the policy's own childBranchPattern) so the baseSha diff stays accurate, or (b) change these two tools to diff against a per-task frozen tree/index snapshot taken at contract-freeze time instead of a commit-range, so they stay accurate on a shared work branch too.
forbidden_actions: Silencing the false positive by weakening the scope check instead of fixing its diff basis
